projects.title: AI Voice Ordering Agent
projects.description: A multilingual AI voice agent for restaurant phone ordering, built on LiveKit Agents.
projects.longDescription: Built a multilingual voice AI agent that handles full restaurant phone orders end-to-end: browsing the menu, building the order, collecting customer details, and confirming the order. Automatically detects and responds in English, Urdu, Roman Urdu, Punjabi, or Hindi, and integrates with Twilio via LiveKit's SIP connector for production telephony.

projects.title: AI Research Agent
projects.description: A Streamlit app that researches any topic on the web and streams a structured report in real time.
projects.longDescription: Built a multi-agent research pipeline with LangGraph: a router classifies input, a planner breaks the topic into sections, parallel researcher nodes search and summarize each section, and a writer streams the final Markdown report token by token. Runs entirely on a local Ollama model with DuckDuckGo search.

projects.title: Automatic License Plate Recognition
projects.description: A YOLO-powered app that detects and reads vehicle license plates from images and video.
projects.longDescription: Built a modular Streamlit application that runs a trained YOLO model on vehicle images or videos to detect and return number-plate bounding boxes. Processes video uploads frame by frame and renders an annotated output video, with a class-based inference wrapper for swapping in different trained weights.

projects.title: Whisper Fine-Tuning for Multilingual ASR
projects.description: Fine-tuned OpenAI's Whisper model for automatic speech recognition on a low-resource language.
projects.longDescription: Fine-tuned openai/whisper-small on Hindi speech from Mozilla Common Voice using Hugging Face Transformers, covering feature extraction, tokenization, training with the Hugging Face Trainer, and word error rate evaluation. Achieved roughly 32% WER after ~4,000 training steps and shipped a Gradio demo for live transcription.

projects.title: RAG Chatbot
projects.description: A document-aware RAG chatbot with document upload, vector search, and user authentication.
projects.longDescription: Built a full-stack Retrieval-Augmented Generation chatbot: a FastAPI backend handles PDF ingestion and chunking, ChromaDB stores vector embeddings for semantic search, and a locally-hosted LLaMA 3 model via Ollama generates context-aware responses. Includes JWT authentication with per-user isolated document collections and a React frontend with markdown rendering.

projects.title: SprintSync
projects.description: An internal work-tracking tool for AI consultancies with LLM-assisted planning.
projects.longDescription: Built a lean task and time-tracking tool for AI consultancies with a Kanban board, analytics dashboard, and JWT-based multi-user auth. Integrated OpenAI GPT-4 to generate task descriptions and daily plans, with a graceful fallback when the AI service is unavailable. Deployed on AWS with fully automated infrastructure provisioning via GitHub Actions.
